top_categories.workout_context: Road-specific control matters at GFNY Pittsburgh. Practice on repeated short, steep paved climbs on a two-loop: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 74 miles.
110ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Pittsburgh's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
At GFNY Pittsburgh, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
8,226ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Pittsburgh. Train it until it feels boring.
8,226ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at GFNY Pittsburgh. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
74 miles on repeated short, steep paved climbs on a two-loop burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.

Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on repeated short, steep paved climbs on a two-loop can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Low-cadence force work supports 8,226ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for GFNY Pittsburgh's 74 miles. Start early, use products you tolerate, and carry enough between the organizer’s confirmed resupply points.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at GFNY Pittsburgh rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on repeated short, steep paved climbs on a two-loop long course to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 74 miles of repeated short, steep paved climbs on a two-loop long course in Monroeville, Pennsylvania, USA.
